items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: So I called Stovall. I said, Stovall, because I didn't know how to get in touch with Irma in California. He gave me her number.

ctx.x: Okay, that was, you know, 73? Yeah, 73.

We went in the Marriott and I, see, they contacted me for the Marriott. And they asked me, who could I get? Did they think I could get Irma? See, because they really just wanted me for it. I said, well, I think, you know, Irma is in California. I said, I think I can get her if I want her. They said, okay, you know, that'd be fine. So I called Stovall.
